The Cislunar Gateway International Habitat (I-HAB) is ESAs contribution of an infrastructure element supporting the Gateway with full crew habitability and utilization requirements from 2025.
 The I-HAB includes contributions from USA, Japan and Canada.
 The Cislunar Gateway is a multi-element infrastructure designed to support both robotic and human exploration of cis-lunar space andact as a basecamp for sustained lunar exploration.
 The Lunar Gateway is smaller than the ISS and will require less launches for its assembly.
 It is intended to be occupied by a crew of up to four astronauts for periods ranging from two weeks to two months, but otherwise operates as a robotic spacecraft.
The objective of the present procurement is the selection of the contractor for I-HAB Independent Software Verification & Validation (ISVV) in accordance with the principles of ESA Best Practices.
The I-HAB Independent Software Verification & Validation (ISVV) is part of the support equipment to integrate and test the I-HAB Gateway module.
The I-HAB Independent Software Verification & Validation (ISVV) function is a technicalactivity performed by a team independent of the developer, aimed to increase the reliability of the Software product and to improve the quality of the development process.
Further information concerning the I-HAB campaign can be found on the Agencys website here:https://www.esa.int/Science_Exploration/Human_and_Robotic_Exploration/Gateway_to_the_Moon
